moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Heats Up
moments.blurb: The Hundred men's and women's cricket tournaments are in full swing across the UK, with matches scheduled daily at venues like Headingley and Sophia Gardens, leading up to the final on August 16th.

angles.name: General UK Buzz
angles.copy: Batting, bowling, and brilliant catches! The Hundred is serving up non-stop action across the country. Who's your pick to win this year?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Focus
angles.copy: Our very own Welsh Fire are battling it out in The Hundred! Huge matches at Sophia Gardens this week - are you cheering them on?

angles.name: London/Yorkshire Matchup
angles.copy: Whether you're rooting for MI London or Sunrisers Leeds, The Hundred is bringing the big hits to your city. Get down to the grounds or tune in!

moments.title: Love Island UK Drama Continues
moments.blurb: The 13th series of Love Island UK, hosted by Maya Jama, is well underway from Mallorca, bringing daily dose of villa drama and recouplings to ITV2 and ITVX.

angles.name: General Drama
angles.copy: Has your head been turned by the latest Love Island drama? The villa is still delivering daily bombshells and fire pit moments!

angles.name: Relationship Status
angles.copy: Are we still 'just friends' or has someone been 'pulled for a chat'? Love Island is still the most talked-about show every night!

moments.title: Kendal Calling Kicks Off Next Week
moments.blurb: Kendal Calling, the popular music and arts festival, returns to Lowther Deer Park in Cumbria from July 30th to August 2nd, featuring a diverse lineup of indie, rock, and pop acts.

angles.name: Festival Excitement
angles.copy: Get ready for the fields! Kendal Calling is almost here, bringing four days of incredible music and good vibes to Cumbria from July 30th. Who are you buzzing to see?

angles.name: Lineup Tease
angles.copy: The countdown is on for Kendal Calling! With a stacked lineup, it's set to be one of the summer's biggest parties. What's making your playlist for the road trip?

moments.title: Happy 75th to Verdine White
moments.blurb: Verdine White, the iconic bassist and co-founder of Earth, Wind & Fire, celebrates his 75th birthday today, July 25th.

angles.name: Funk Legend
angles.copy: Seventy-five years young! Sending huge birthday wishes to the legendary Verdine White of Earth, Wind & Fire. What's your favourite EWF track?

angles.name: Music Icon
angles.copy: He's still shining star! Happy 75th Birthday to Earth, Wind & Fire's incredible bassist, Verdine White. Turn up the funk today!

moments.title: Mick Jagger Turns 83 Tomorrow
moments.blurb: The Rolling Stones' legendary frontman, Mick Jagger, will celebrate his 83rd birthday tomorrow, July 26th.

source.l: Associated Press / Off The Wall School Of Music

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Can you believe it? Mick Jagger turns 83 tomorrow! The ageless rock 'n' roll legend is still moving like Jagger. What's your all-time favourite Stones song?

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Get ready to wish a very happy 83rd birthday to the one and only Mick Jagger tomorrow! What a career, what a performer.

moments.title: Rush's Geddy Lee Turns 73
moments.blurb: Geddy Lee, the influential bassist, vocalist, and keyboardist for progressive rock legends Rush, celebrates his 73rd birthday on July 29th.

angles.name: Prog Rock Legend
angles.copy: A true pioneer of progressive rock! Wishing a very happy 73rd birthday to Rush's iconic frontman, Geddy Lee, on July 29th. What's your favourite Rush epic?

angles.name: Musical Influence
angles.copy: From complex basslines to soaring vocals, Geddy Lee has inspired generations. Happy 73rd to the Rush legend this Wednesday!

moments.title: Def Leppard's Joe Elliott is 67
moments.blurb: Def Leppard's powerhouse vocalist, Joe Elliott, celebrates his 67th birthday on August 1st.

angles.name: Rock Vocalist
angles.copy: Pour some sugar on him! Happy 67th Birthday to Def Leppard's incredible frontman, Joe Elliott, this Saturday. Rock on!

angles.name: Def Leppard Shoutout
angles.copy: From Sheffield to stadiums worldwide, Joe Elliott has led Def Leppard for decades. Wishing him a fantastic 67th birthday on August 1st!

moments.title: Counting Crows' Adam Duritz Turns 62
moments.blurb: Adam Duritz, the distinctive voice and frontman of Counting Crows, celebrates his 62nd birthday on August 1st.

angles.name: Alternative Icon
angles.copy: He's got that long December feeling... of a birthday! Happy 62nd to Counting Crows' Adam Duritz on August 1st. What's your go-to Counting Crows track?

angles.name: Counting Crows Love
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 62nd birthday to the lyrical genius, Adam Duritz of Counting Crows, this Saturday! Still love those '90s anthems.

moments.title: Public Enemy's Chuck D is 66
moments.blurb: Carlton Douglas Ridenhour, famously known as Chuck D, the influential leader of Public Enemy, celebrates his 66th birthday on August 1st.

source.l: Associated Press / Musicians born on August 1

angles.name: Hip Hop Legend
angles.copy: Don't believe the hype, it's his birthday! Happy 66th to the legendary Chuck D of Public Enemy this Saturday. A true voice for the ages.

angles.name: Public Enemy Influence
angles.copy: Still fighting the power! Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to hip hop icon Chuck D on August 1st. His impact is undeniable.

moments.title: L7's Suzi Gardner Turns 66
moments.blurb: Suzi Gardner, co-founder, guitarist, and vocalist of the groundbreaking grunge band L7, celebrates her 66th birthday on August 1st.

source.l: Associated Press / Musicians born on August 1

angles.name: Grunge Pioneer
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to the incredible Suzi Gardner of L7 this Saturday! A true force in '90s rock. What's your favourite L7 track?

angles.name: L7 Shoutout
angles.copy: From grunge anthems to powerful performances, Suzi Gardner helped define an era. Wishing her a very happy 66th on August 1st!

moments.title: Mixed Summer Weather Ahead for UK
moments.blurb: After a very warm July for some, the UK weather is set to become more changeable over the weekend and into next week, with temperatures easing for many but still reaching the high 20s in the South East.

angles.name: Weekend Weather Outlook
angles.copy: Get those brollies ready! The UK's summer weather is turning a bit more mixed this weekend. Still some sunshine, but a few showers might pop up. What are your plans?

angles.name: South East Sunshine
angles.copy: Still feeling summery in the South East, with temperatures in the high 20s expected this weekend! Perfect for enjoying those outdoor plans.

angles.name: Devon Forecast
angles.copy: Devon, get ready for a more changeable forecast this weekend. Keep an eye on the skies, but there'll still be chances to enjoy our beautiful county!
